result.quote: their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, “He is our brother.”
result.reason: The verse explicitly gives their belief that Abimelech was their brother as the reason they were inclined to follow him. “Your own flesh and blood” is a paraphrase of the same reason, not a materially different answer.
